# 0.8.0 — Strict CI gates and catalogue fixes

30 September 2026. Minor on **0.7.0**.

Upgrade and regenerate CI with `opentide setup ci`. Validation and lint are now strict, deploy skips a plan whose platforms have no tenants, and an Azure pipeline declares a pool. An object file with no `uuid` fails validation. `get_chaining` returns threat, objective, and rule lineage.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.8.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

Regenerate an existing workflow with `opentide setup ci <github|gitlab|azure> --yes`. On Azure Repos, also add a build validation policy on the default branch so a pull request sets `Build.Reason` to `PullRequest`. The pipeline file cannot create that policy.

## Added

- `opentide deploy --skip-unconfigured` exits 0 when every platform in the plan has no `[[tenants]]` block ([#408](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/408)).
- Generated GitHub deploy jobs map bundled platform credentials from `secrets`. There is no `OPENTIDE_SECRETS` variable ([#408](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/408)).

## Changed

- Generated gates are `opentide validate --strict` and `opentide lint --strict` ([#409](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/409)).
- Azure pipelines set `pool.vmImage` to `ubuntu-latest` and trigger every branch. Staging stays gated on `Build.Reason` `PullRequest` ([#398](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/398)).
- `lint` prints `ISSUES` when findings exist. Exit code stays 0 unless `--strict`.
- MCP `get_chaining` returns threat → objective → rule lineage. A non-empty `threat.chaining` map stays in `graph` ([#407](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/407)).

## Fixed

- Object YAML with no `uuid` fails the schema check as `missing_uuid` ([#397](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/397)).
- Detached-HEAD `deploy --plan STAGING` fetches `origin` instead of `list index out of range` ([#402](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/402), [#415](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/415)).
- Inflight prune creates `.opentide/inflight` before `git add` ([#403](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/403)).
- `setup skills` installs the full skill tree, package `AGENTS.md`, and current authoring skills ([#399](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/399), [#405](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/405)).
- `setup repo` keeps empty scaffold directories in git, does not hardcode Sentinel, and warns when README flags are ignored ([#400](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/400), [#404](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/404)).
- `generate docs` writes section indexes for an empty folder ([#401](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/401)).
- Installation pages name 0.8.0 as the latest release ([#406](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/406)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide deploy --help
opentide setup ci azure --help
```

Expect `0.8.0`.
